components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button with solid ink background, acid yellow text, and mechanical press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; background: #09090B; color: #D2E823; border: 2px solid #09090B; border-radius: 12px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 20px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px #09090B; cursor: pointer; transition: all 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); user-select: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1a1a1f; transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px 0px #09090B; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px 0px #09090B; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #09090B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Subtle secondary action button with transparent background, revealing acid tint and solid border on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; background: transparent; color: #09090B; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(210, 232, 35, 0.3); border-color: #09090B; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #09090B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirmation button in coral red with ink border and mechanical depression.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; background: #FF334B; color: #09090B; border: 2px solid #09090B; border-radius: 12px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 20px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px #09090B; cursor: pointer; transition: all 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #ff4f63; transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px 0px #09090B; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px 0px #09090B; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #09090B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Small Button
components.description: Compact action button with 2px hard shadow and 8px border radius.

components.name: Status Badge

components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; background: #09090B; color: #D2E823; border: 2px solid #09090B; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px 0px #09090B; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: High-contrast form input with cream background, 2px offset shadow, and hard focus shift.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search reference or account..." />
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 44px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; background: #F8F4E8; color: #09090B; border: 2px solid #09090B; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 14px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px 0px #09090B; transition: all 120ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #52525B; } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px #09090B; transform: translate(-1px, -1px); outline: 2px solid #09090B; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
ReliefOps evokes the physical gravity of a Japanese banking relief operations desk. Heavy black ink strokes, warm archival cream paper, and mechanical tactile feedback replace ephemeral tech aesthetics with bureaucratic permanence and statutory rigor. Every surface behaves like physical paper bound in heavy black ledger boards.

The interface prioritizes dense, unambiguous clarity for operators handling time-critical fraud claims under legal scrutiny. High-contrast typography and deliberate tactile feedback ensure operators work with absolute focus and confidence under strict statutory deadlines.
keyCharacteristics: Archival cream paper foundations grounded by 2px solid ink structural outlines.
Hard neo-brutalist offset drop-shadows with zero blur radius and mechanical click action.
High-contrast tripartite typography: authoritative display headings, utilitarian body, and tabular monospace numerals.
Restrained high-visibility functional signals: acid yellow for focused action, coral red strictly for statutory danger.

rules.name: The Coral Discipline Rule
rules.body: Coral (#FF334B) is strictly reserved for statutory danger, critical failures, and overdue deadlines. It is never used for generic notification badges or decorative alerts.

rules.name: The Acid Accent Rule
rules.body: Acid yellow (#D2E823) represents operational focus and primary forward momentum: active navigation tabs, interactive focus states, primary selections, and high-priority action emphasis.

rules.name: The Restrained Display Rule
rules.body: Dela Gothic One is used exclusively for primary page h1 headings and modal dialog titles. It must never appear on card headers, subheaders, body text, or statistics counters.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Doctrine
rules.body: Page headings (h1) and modal titles are rendered in clean sentence case. Never apply uppercase to Dela Gothic One page titles.

rules.name: The Mechanical Press Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements press physically into their shadow on hover (translate(2px, 2px) with shadow reducing to 2px) and fully compress on active press (translate(4px, 4px) with zero shadow).

rules.name: The Modal Nesting Rule
rules.body: Panels and cards nested inside a modal must omit all drop-shadows and use a muted border (border border-[#09090B]/15) to prevent visual stacking clash.

dos: Do use Dela Gothic One only for top-level page h1 and modal dialog titles.
Do format page h1 headings in sentence case with subtitle text-sm text-[#52525B].
Do build primary panels with border-2 border-[#09090B] rounded-2xl shadow-hard and p-4 sm:p-6 padding.
Do style nested panels inside modals with border border-[#09090B]/15 and zero shadow.
Do style table headers with text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#52525B] on transparent background.
Do highlight focused table rows with bg-[#D2E823]/25 tint across the row.
Do apply focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#09090B] for accessible keyboard focus rings.
Do use JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums for all currency amounts, case references, timestamps, and account numbers.
donts: Don't use Dela Gothic One for card titles, stat values, table cells, badges, or buttons.
Don't use uppercase on page h1 headings.
Don't use coral (#FF334B) for standard counters, decorative badges, or non-urgent notifications.
Don't add colored side-stripe borders on focused table rows.
Don't use fuzzy, blurred, or ambient drop-shadows; keep all shadows crisp hard-edge 0px blur.
Don't use banned elements: glitch text, stickers, marquees, custom cursor, noise overlay, or side-stripe borders.
Don't use banned hype words in interfaces: syndicate, telemetry, command.
